findings.summary: adopting the review resolver replaces ancestry ordering with last-manifest-entry, so a newest-first manifest reads its head as the oldest commit
findings.text: `_run_head` now returns `_run_head_for_review`, whose reclaimed-worktree branch is `_record_citation`'s `_record_carried_head` at reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:812, which walks `commits:` in reverse and returns the last resolvable entry. The deleted `_newest_cited_commit` answered the same question by `git rev-list --topo-order --max-count=1` over every cited commit, so it was correct in any ordering. A manifest listing its commits newest-first therefore resolves the head to its oldest cited commit, and an after arm recorded at that commit compares equal to the head and is accepted, which is the trailing-arm case §16 exists to refuse. The behaviour is inherited from the shared owner, but this diff is what makes it reachable from the promotion gate.

findings.summary: the released-worktree case's docstring still describes the ancestry mechanism this change removed
findings.text: The docstring reads "With no worktree the head is the newest cited commit by ancestry", which is the `_newest_cited_commit` path deleted by 269f61739f; the case now exercises the record's carried head through `_run_head_for_review`, which takes the last manifest entry rather than the newest by ancestry. A reader debugging a released-worktree refusal is pointed at a mechanism that is no longer in the tree, and the two rules differ exactly in the ordering case the first finding names.

item_verdicts.goal: The node's goal is that a promotion refuses an after-suite arm recorded at a trailing revision and names both revisions; at head 1a546012be the refusal is unchanged (reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:941 and :1032 pass the head into `_arm_missing_fields`) and reckons/crew/promotion_records.py:610 now reads that head through the review path, so the goal still holds and the duplicated reader the prior review scored 5 on is gone.

item_verdicts.write_paths: The node was fenced to reckon/crew/promotion_records.py, its new test, the evidence fragment and a figures directory; `git diff --stat 86bda2e3c8..1a546012be` touches exactly promotion_records.py (21 insertions, 106 deletions) and the fragment (22 insertions, 17 deletions), and the one commit outside that pair, 1a546012be, changes the fragment only.
